mapper.insert: INSERT INTO evaluation_task (semester_id, start_time, end_time, status, create_time) VALUES (#{semesterId}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, 1, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT et.*, sem.name AS semester_name FROM evaluation_task et LEFT JOIN semester sem ON sem.id = et.semester_id WHERE et.id = #{id}
SELECT et.*, sem.name AS semester_name FROM evaluation_task et LEFT JOIN semester sem ON sem.id = et.semester_id ORDER BY et.id DESC
SELECT et.*, sem.name AS semester_name FROM evaluation_task et LEFT JOIN semester sem ON sem.id = et.semester_id WHERE et.semester_id = #{semesterId} AND et.status = 1 ORDER BY et.id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM evaluation_task WHERE semester_id = #{semesterId} AND status = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE evaluation_task SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
